# Spec & Plan Quality Checklist: Shared Agent Base Image

**Purpose**: Validate that this feature's spec and plan are complete, consistent, unambiguous, and
testable — a requirements-quality review, not an implementation test.
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are requirements defined for every image the feature touches — the shared base and all four harnesses? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does the spec enumerate the full common tool set that must live in the base, with none left implicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements stated for what the base MUST NOT contain (no harness install, entrypoint, or harness-specific env)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the Python-runtime requirement complete — interpreter, package installer, and the pinned `dagster-pipes` all specified as base-provided? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for the one-line "common tooling from agent-base" pointer in each thin harness image? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are build-order requirements defined for both build entry points (README steps and `scripts/bootstrap.sh`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK007 - Does the spec define what each thinned harness image MUST retain (harness install, entrypoint, harness-specific env)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the documented-reason requirement for a standalone harness present and attached to a specific harness? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 - Is "standard build essentials" defined concretely enough to implement without guessing which packages are included? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002 / Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "identical behavior / same report, same output" disambiguated from byte-identical live reruns? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "combined on-disk footprint is smaller" defined as deduplicated usage counting the shared base once, rather than the sum of per-image sizes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "exactly one place" for the common tool list unambiguous about which single artifact is the source of truth? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "a harness that genuinely cannot use the shared base" given objective criteria rather than left to interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the pinned `dagster-pipes` tied to a specific version rather than referenced only as "pinned"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Consistency (Spec ↔ Plan)

- [ ] CHK015 - Does the common tool set in Spec §FR-002 match the apt tool list in the plan's Primary Dependencies exactly (no tool added or dropped)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 / Plan Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the `dagster-pipes==1.13.21` version consistent across spec, plan, research, data-model, and the contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013 / Plan]
- [ ] CHK017 - Does the plan's list of files touched match the scope the spec fixes (base + four harness Dockerfiles + `scripts/bootstrap.sh` + README, no YAML)? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope / Plan Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the plan's `node:20-slim` base choice consistent with the spec's technology-agnostic stance and its "Node-bearing base" assumption? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions / Plan R1]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does the plan's constitution check stay consistent with the spec's no-new-capability / no-secret intent? [Consistency, Plan Constitution Check]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality (Measurability & Testability)

- [ ] CHK020 - Is every success criterion (SC-001..SC-006) stated with an objective, defined verification method? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK021 - Can behavioral parity (SC-002) be objectively verified through its stated proxy — unchanged wrapper/report code and `images/tests` passing unchanged? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the footprint success criterion (SC-005) measurable with a named method (deduplicated store size) rather than an unqualified "smaller"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK023 - Does each functional requirement trace to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §FR / §SC]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are the "tools resolve to executables" checks (SC-004/FR-007) tied to a concrete, checkable set of binaries? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007/SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements complete, clear, and consistent for the primary "add a tool in one place" flow? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for the standalone / null-action exception flow? [Coverage, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the "no agent YAML changes" invariant expressed as a verifiable requirement across all user stories? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009/SC-006]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for a harness needing a tool no other agent needs (kept in that harness, not the shared list)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is the build-ordering failure mode (a harness built before the base) addressed in requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases / FR-012]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is behavior specified if the external GitHub CLI apt repo or its arm64 build is unavailable on the target? [Edge Case, Gap, Plan R2]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 - Are the build-speed / footprint outcomes (US3) specified with a measurable expectation rather than a qualitative "faster"? [NFR, Spec §US3 / SC-005]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are isolation and secrets constraints stated as requirements (no new agent capability, no secret baked into any image or build arg)? [NFR, Plan Constitution Check I/III]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 - Is the assumption that the four existing harnesses are the complete set documented and validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the assumption that `node:20-slim` already ships the uid-1000 `node` user recorded so the base need not re-create it? [Assumption, Plan R1 / Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the external dependency on the GitHub CLI apt repository (with arm64 support) documented? [Dependency, Plan R2]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK036 - Is the pre-existing README build-context bug (context vs. `COPY lib/`) resolution stated unambiguously and marked in scope? [Conflict, Plan R4 / Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the duplicated `dagster-pipes` pin (shared base + standalone `agent-python`) acknowledged as intentional rather than an unresolved conflict? [Conflict, Plan Complexity Tracking]
- [ ] CHK038 - Does FR-013's "no shell-based harness re-declares them" stay non-contradictory with `agent-python` keeping its own pin (i.e. is `agent-python` clearly outside the shell-based set)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013 / FR-010]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
